text:
lee: Morning — quick async standup.
lee: What I did: finished baseline eval for rifty-v1 on en/es prompt set, pushed metrics to the eval dashboard.
lee: Blockers: seeing a ~4% BLEU-style drop on slot-filling cases (examples attached). Can't repro locally with CPU run.
lee: Today: investigating KV-warmup timing differences on GPU nodes, will try a cast-to-fp16 patch.

sara: saw the drop, flagged two failing examples in the dashboard. Might be a tokenization mismatch after the tokenizer update.
sara: quick check: can you run `python -m rifty.eval --dataset slotfill --seed 42 --device cpu` and paste a failing example output? :eyes:

lee: running now, results below.
lee: ```
Input: "Fill: name=__, action=book"
Expected: "name=Alice"
Predicted: "name=Alix"
Logprobs: -3.21
``` 
lee: looks like subtle spelling truncation.

olivia: re: tokenizer, we shipped a patch that normalizes curly apostrophes on staging. Could be related. I can revert the normalization on a single model to test.

jason: @lee @olivia I can repro the token split locally when I load the new tokenizer; looks like `'` -> `’` mapping shifts token boundaries.
jason: quick patch suggestion: in serving config set `tokenizer.normalization: false` for rifty-v1 and run smoke tests.

lee: thanks. I'll flip that in a canary and run the evals again. If green, we'll roll to the rest.

qa-bot: perf-check passed on canary (p99 latency 48ms) :white_check_mark:

sara: if the canary fixes the BLEU drop, we should add a prompt-level regression test for slotfill edgecases.

lee: agreed — I'll add a small promptset and link to the eval job once stable.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by lee for tag rifty-v1+token-fix; will run at 6318005000 unless cancelled.

jason: leaving a code review ping — PR #4127 touches tokenizer mapping, @olivia can you take a look? :pray:

olivia: on it, will review within the hour.

lee: thanks all — ping here for any quick blockers. :coffee:
